args.title: checkout-api rolled back to v2.3.0 after failed v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

1. **Investigated:** Checked the deployment history for checkout-api. The latest deploy (v2.3.1) was unhealthy; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back:** Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Status: `rolled_out`, verified.
3. **Opened incident:** Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommend monitoring health checks to confirm full recovery, and investigating v2.3.1 before any re-deploy.
